-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.Protocol.RefinementDyn` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem appKnow_of_msg [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (r : RState) (m : Msg) (Hty : m.ty
    = MsgType.app) (Hdyn : γ.reDyn ≠ none) (HwR : PlogWf base0 r.full) : ⊢ isMessage γ m -∗ logRecs
    γ base0 r.full -∗ ⌜AppKnow r m⌝

theorem DynCfg.mk.congr_simp (fold fold✝ : List EntryM → Option CfgM) (e_fold : fold = fold✝) (adj :
    ∀ (P1 P2 : List EntryM) (c1 c2 : CfgM), P1 <+: P2 → confCount P2 ≤ confCount P1 + 1 → fold P1 =
    some c1 → fold P2 = some c2 → QOverlap c1 c2) : { fold := fold, adj := adj } = { fold := fold✝,
    adj := ⋯ }

def ownRaftGhostR [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (id : w64)
    (r : RState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownRaftGhost γ id r.p true ∗
      ⌜RInv dec c0 r⌝ ∗ logRecs γ base0 r.fp ∗ ∀ x, isCampK γ id r.p.term r.full r.p.commit)

theorem ownRaftGhostR_stepR [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState)
    (h0 : CfgOk c0) (HD : γ.dyn = some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0)) (S : List EntryM → Prop) (id :
    w64) (B : Int) (HB : B < 2 ^ 64) (r : RState) (recv : List Msg) (r' : RState) : StepR (AdmS dec
    c0 S) dec id B r recv r' → ⊢ ⧖(B.toNat - γ.reBoot.length) -∗ (□ ∀ fp, ⌜S fp⌝ -∗ logRecs γ base0
    fp) -∗ ([∗list] m ∈ recv, isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount recv) -∗ msgsTks γ recv -∗ £ 1 -∗
    ownRaftGhostR γ dec c0 id r ={⊤}=∗ ownRaftGhostR γ dec c0 id r'

theorem noApp0 {dec : CCDec} {c0 : CCState} (r1 : RState) (m' : Msg) : m' ∈ [] → m'.ty = MsgType.app
    → RInv dec c0 r1 → AppKnow r1 m'

theorem full_take_eq_pure (F1 F2 : List EntryM) (c : w64) (Hw1 : PlogWf base0 F1) (Hw2 : PlogWf
    base0 F2) (HRA : RecsAgree base0 F1 base0 F2) (Hs : (plogTermAt base0 F1 c).isSome = true) (Heq
    : plogTermAt base0 F1 c = plogTermAt base0 F2 c) : List.take (uint.Z c).toNat F1 = List.take
    (uint.Z c).toNat F2

theorem ownRaftGhostR_env [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (h0
    : CfgOk c0) (HD : γ.dyn = some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0)) (id : w64) (r : RState) (HI : RInv dec
    c0 r) (Hs : r.snap = false) : ⊢ logRecs γ base0 r.fp -∗ (∀ x, isCampK γ id r.p.term r.full
    r.p.commit) -∗ dynEnv γ id r.cfg.cfg r.p

theorem cfgAt_of_fold {γ : RaftNames} {dec : CCDec} {c0 : CCState} {h0 : CfgOk c0} (HD : γ.dyn =
    some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0)) {P : List EntryM} {s : CCState} (h : cfgFold dec c0 P = some s)
    : CfgAt γ P s.cfg

theorem appKnow_pure (r : RState) (m : Msg) (bL : entryID) (fp l : List EntryM) (HwR : PlogWf base0
    r.full) (Hpay : AppPayloadOk m) (Hprev : plogTermAt bL l m.index = some m.logterm) (Hpre :
    m.entries <+: plogFrom bL l (m.index + W64 1)) (Hfl : FullOk bL fp) (HwF : PlogWf base0 (fp ++
    l)) (HI1 : ConfI1 (fp ++ l) (uint.nat m.commit)) (HRA : RecsAgree base0 r.full base0 (fp ++ l))
    : AppKnow r m

def DynCfg.ofFold (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (h0 : CfgOk c0) : DynCfg :=
  { fold := fun P => Option.map (fun s => s.cfg) (cfgFold dec c0 P), adj := ⋯ }

theorem noApp1 {dec : CCDec} {c0 : CCState} {m : Msg} (h : m.ty ≠ MsgType.app) (r1 : RState) (m' :
    Msg) : m' ∈ [m] → m'.ty = MsgType.app → RInv dec c0 r1 → AppKnow r1 m'

theorem reDyn_of {γ : RaftNames} {D : DynCfg} (HD : γ.dyn = some D) : γ.reDyn ≠ none

theorem toNat_uZ (w : w64) : (uint.Z w).toNat = uint.nat w

theorem DynCfg.ofFold.congr_simp (dec dec✝ : CCDec) (e_dec : dec = dec✝) (c0 c0✝ : CCState) (e_c0 :
    c0 = c0✝) (h0 : CfgOk c0) : DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0 = DynCfg.ofFold dec✝ c0✝ ⋯

def AdmS (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (S : List EntryM → Prop) (l : List EntryM) (cs : CCState) :
    Prop :=
  AdmFold dec c0 l cs ∧ S l

theorem ownRaftGhost_logRecs [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (md :
    Bool) : ⊢ ownRaftGhost γ id s md -∗ ⌜PlogWf s.base s.log⌝ ∗ logRecs γ s.base s.log

theorem ownRaftGhostR_stepR_in [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (dec : CCDec) (c0 :
    CCState) (h0 : CfgOk c0) (HD : γ.dyn = some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0)) (S : List EntryM → Prop)
    (id : w64) (B : Int) (HB : B < 2 ^ 64) (r : RState) (recv : List Msg) (r' : RState) : StepR
    (AdmS dec c0 S) dec id B r recv r' → ⊢ ⧖(B.toNat - γ.reBoot.length) -∗ regsOwn γ -∗ (□ ∀ fp, ⌜S
    fp⌝ -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp) -∗ ([∗list] m ∈ recv, isMessage γ m) -∗ rdCred γ (rdCount recv) -∗
    msgsTks γ recv -∗ ownRaftGhostR γ dec c0 id r ={⊤ \ ↑(raftRegN γ)}=∗ regsOwn γ ∗ ownRaftGhostR γ
    dec c0 id r'
